prepared_for: Magali Rady, Jad Chbeir and the YKONE Middle East team
title: Egypt, under your *creative lead.*
subtitle: How NOYA runs the Egypt side of a YKONE brief, and what we need from you to propose.

blocks.text: YKONE is looking at the Egypt market. NOYA is a UK-based concierge and destination management company specialising in Egypt. This brief turns our conversation of 8 October into a working method, so the next YKONE brief that points to Egypt can move straight to a proposal.
YKONE leads the creative vision and brand relationships, while NOYA brings together the right people, places and experiences to make it happen.

right.title: NOYA delivers in Egypt
items: Locations, venues and permits, with our local production partners
Hotels, villas and residences for talent, guests and crew

blocks.text: The client relationship stays with YKONE. NOYA works behind your brand, as the Egypt team you can call on for any brief.

rows: Creator trips · campaign and editorial shoots · brand dinners and activations · product launches · press trips · brand retreats.
Pyramids of Giza · Grand Egyptian Museum · Cairo · El Gouna and the Red Sea · North Coast · Luxor and Aswan.
The opening of the Grand Egyptian Museum, new luxury hospitality across Cairo, El Gouna and the North Coast, and a growing calendar of international events.
Location sourcing and permits through our local partners, with crew coordination from concept to wrap.

blocks.label: For a YKONE client
blocks.big: A private brand dinner at the Pyramids or the Grand Egyptian Museum.
paras: Talent arrivals, stays and guest hosting handled end to end by NOYA, under YKONE's creative lead.
The evening becomes the content: creators arrive the day before, the dinner is the centrepiece, and a private guided visit the next morning gives a second story.

items.text: VIP airport reception, private transfers and check-in. A quiet welcome dinner for talent.
The brand dinner. Venue, permits, catering, staging partners and guest hosting managed by NOYA.
A private guided visit for content, then departures.

blocks.text: Indicative only. Timings, venues and access are confirmed with permits and availability once the programme is agreed.
Share what you can. The client's name can stay confidential until there is a fit.

fields.label: Format
fields.hint: Shoot, creator trip, dinner, launch, press trip

fields.label: Talent and guests
fields.hint: Numbers, and any names already attached

fields.label: Creative references
fields.hint: Mood, references, the feeling the brand wants

blocks.text: Return to noya@noyaconcierge.com, or reply to our email with whatever is known today. We will come back with questions only where they change the proposal.

items.title: Share a live or upcoming brief
items.text: Any brief where Egypt could fit, this quarter or next.

items.title: NOYA returns a concept and a costed proposal
items.text: Locations, hospitality and logistics with a clear budget, ready for YKONE to present to its client.

items.title: Holds and permits
items.text: Once approved, NOYA holds venues and begins permits with our local partners.
